name: support-l1-nightshift
jobText:
L1 Support Engineer — Night Shift (Rotational)

We are hiring an L1 Support Engineer for our 24x7 support desk. This role works a rotational night shift covering our global ticket queue.

Responsibilities:
- Monitor and triage incoming support tickets
- Escalate unresolved issues to L2/L3 teams
- Follow runbooks to restore service for common incidents
- Maintain shift handover notes

Requirements:
- 1-2 years of experience in a technical support role
- Basic Linux troubleshooting skills
- Willingness to work a rotational night shift

This is an entry-level, ticket-queue role with a defined escalation path — you will not own infrastructure decisions.
